steps.content:
November 28, N.F. 114
City Hall, 105th Street, District 3, Eastside
The 9th Agency, FAC & MBCC Joint Investigation Team

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Prime Minister Stewart and his cabinet were in a meeting when it happened. The assassins appeared inside the chamber and struck them instantly. The scene was heavily damaged, and cleanup is underway.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: So far, 26 human remains have been recovered, including those of the Prime Minister, 11 cabinet officials and 14 residence guards. In addition, 6 Elite Escort HUSH units were found completely destroyed, along with the remains of 18 Underground puppets.
Based on the images, it seems unlikely that Prime Minister could have been transported to a hospital. Just the process of identification of his remains will take considerable efforts.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I remember the news said three people were injured.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Actually, only <color=#fb9259>one</color> left now.

As the live feed plays out before you, a man is revealed strapped to an operating table. While his contorted face retains traces of familiarity, his piercing screams now carry an unsettling, inhuman nature.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Ahh... No... Stay back... Stay back... Ahh, mmm... Guards, guards... Gua—

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: Aaahhhhh—!!

It's Guillotin, Chief of the Outland Affairs Bureau. You have collaborated with him extensively on WhiteSands affairs, witnessing his arrogant swagger as well as having a chuckle over his frustrated tantrums.
Yet, you never expected he would meet such a fate.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Mr. Guillotine was found in a closet on the top floor, and his used wine glass was discovered in the adjacent drawing room. It is believed that he did not attend the meeting and was placed in the drawing room instead.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Thanks to that, he avoided the direct attack when it happened. But unfortunately, he suffered severe mental contamination under the extreme conditions.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Banyan Medical College is doing everything it can to save him. Once he regains his faculties, he should be able to provide the investigation team with valuable information.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: That's not gonna happen. Even if a miracle happens, time is not on our side. We just hope he doesn't end up like the other two and turn into a Corruptor.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Chief, we need your assessment at the scene, if you please.
Once again,  several groans penetrate your ears through the communication device, oscillating between human and bestial. Instinctively, you avert your gaze.
(Scene change)

The scene at the site turns out even more nauseating. A mixture of contamination and bloody flesh is smeared across the room with savage abandon. Mutilated bodies hang from spikes, while formal suits soak in pools of putrid fluid. Somehow, witnessing power and death shattered and intertwined like this leaves you with an inexplicable sense of dislocation.
You are led to one of the remaining "assailants."
[Illustration] Monster
This particular type of Underground Puppet is unfamiliar to you. Its "raincoat" fits more tightly than the previous models.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Yes. Its Mania readings are similar to previous models—only the appearance has changed. With reduced defense but more agile, better suited for assassination purposes.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Based on what we have, they infiltrated through the vent in a liquid state, solidified upon entry, and neutralized all targets within minutes. Then they engaged in combat with the responding security force until they were completely eliminated.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: However, when we mock the combat, certain pieces of evidence don't add up. We can't make sense of them.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Chief, you know about these creatures. What do you think?
[Simple Touch Investigation] Interact according to corresponding images
Strange markings are scattered across both the walls and floor. Some exhibit eye-like patterns, while others consist of nothing more than fragmented, incomprehensible lines.
Within the grooves of these marks, peculiar sludge remains writhing—a mixture that appears to be Puppet fluid combined with human flesh and blood.
Setting aside those disordered marks, the sparse bloodstains indicate that all the officials were killed in the same instant.
These Underground Puppets executed their attack with surgical precision—ordinary humans wouldn't be able to react.
The scene underwent a dramatic change only after the HUSH force burst in. Both the contamination-formed spikes and the original furniture were battered in the ensuing battle.
The remaining traces show that the HUSH units had inflicted considerable damage on the Puppets, even managing to gain the upper hand during the combat.
Combining the analysis report provided with your observations, you close your eyes and let your thoughts take shape. The scene of the attack gradually pieces itself together in your mind—
